name: Hand-drawn MMORPG for humans and AI agents

mentions.name: Hand-drawn MMORPG for humans and AI agents
mentions.description: A hand-drawn MMORPG where humans play in one world while bots and AI agents play in another, and both meet in a shared town. Bots play over plain HTTP, so a few lines of JS or an LLM agent can participate.
